fieldValues.title: Should every line of a transcript become part of a fragment record?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: Raised by the tension between the owner's stage list (slice the transcript into fragments) and proposed decision a089adfd (only the fragments that carry meaning become records). No option chosen.
fieldValues.tensions:
Options, none chosen:
- A. Full slicing, as the prototype: every line in a fragment, off-the-record ones without words.
- B. Only fragments used as evidence become records; the slicing is kept as ranges in one index record.
- C. Full slicing while working; off-the-record fragments dropped at export.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: Whether coverage (nothing unaccounted for) is worth the extra records; 62 fragments for a 43 KB transcript, 9 of them off the record.
fieldValues.next_action: Ask the group whether a list of what was left out of the minutes is useful to them.
